Arm A (no allowlist) and arm B (enabled_tools=[get_account,get_positions]) use the same prompt, sandbox=read-only, same policy.md developer instructions.

The real Alpaca paper MCP arm is out of scope for this unit (broker contact belongs to peer session sota-workflow-resolution) so the gap cannot be settled here; best outcome advanced.
If the model refuses in arm A because of the policy prompt rather than a mechanism, record it as a policy-prompt block, not an enforcement result.
